native.rule_saved: Rule saved — pushing to the gateway and updating AGENTS.md
native.rules_explain: Hard rules are enforced by the system while an agent runs — they don't depend on the agent "remembering" or "wanting" to follow them. Violating answers are sent back for a rewrite, outbound channel messages are scrubbed or cancelled, forbidden tools are blocked and sensitive tools wait for a human. Every catch is logged and counted in each seat's compliance rate.
native.charter_desc: Prohibitions are plain sentences; any without a hard rule is still only text in AGENTS.md.
native.f_external_only: Only when sending outside the company (customer channels, outside agents)
native.pat_hint_regex: Syntax shared by Python/JavaScript; no inline flags such as (?i).
native.pat_hint_pii: phone, email, cccd, card — comma separated.
native.rules_empty_hint: Start from a template above, or turn a charter prohibition into a rule.
native.probe_desc: Type an answer or a tool name to see which rules catch it — the same check the MCP gate uses.
native.compliance_note: Compliance = runs without a violation / all runs. Violations in chat or A2A (no run attached) each count as one violating run.
native.contracts_explain: Every position / process step has a data contract: input data, required output fields and acceptance criteria. Agents submit with company_task_submit_output; the system checks instantly — a non-conforming output is sent back with concrete errors, and after the allowed number of attempts the task is blocked and escalated to a human along the reporting line. Next steps read the output fields directly (branch conditions step<N>.output.<field>) instead of parsing free text.
native.c_saved: Contract saved — the position's AGENTS.md is being updated
native.c_bad_json: The schema is not valid JSON — check brackets and commas.
native.c_position_hint: The seat's standard output — compiled into AGENTS.md
native.c_outcome_hint: This field's value becomes the step outcome (branching)
native.c_schema_hint: JSON Schema subset: {p0}. For strings min/max is the length; for lists the number of items.
native.c_input_hint: What the task receives when its turn comes: run input + previous step outputs. Missing required fields → a warning on the task.
native.c_empty_hint: Pick a template (e.g. Refund request), then attach it to a position or to a process step in the Processes tab.
native.c_try_desc: Paste the output JSON — checked by the same function agents hit when submitting; nothing is saved.
native.c_rate_note: Last 30 days. A run that ends without submitting counts as a failed submission.
native.coverage_explain: Agent seats are on duty 24/7 — no working hours, leave or public holidays. Human seats have weekly working hours (Vietnam time) and days off. SLAs count the on-duty minutes of the assigned seat; a breach escalates to a human along the reporting line. Work that arrives while a human is off duty goes to an agent with the same position; without one it is queued with the time that person will pick it up.
native.cov_no_seats: No seats in this position yet.
native.sla_hint: On-duty minutes: agent seats = wall clock 24/7; human seats = only minutes inside working hours. First response = task moves to In progress. A process step SLA wins over a position SLA.
native.sched_hint: One or more "HH:MM-HH:MM" ranges per day, comma separated; empty = day off. Vietnam time.
native.observe_holidays: Off on public holidays (organization holiday calendar)
native.ahr_explain: Workforce metrics built for agent seats ({p0} days): following hard rules, submitting outputs that match the data contract, giving the same quality for the same input (consistency), meeting SLAs, working outside office hours, and USD cost per task. Human seats keep normal HR records.
native.ahr_no_agents: No agent seats in this company.
native.ahr_no_humans: No human seats — every position is staffed by agents.
native.ahr_note: Consistency = 1 − 2 × standard deviation of quality across k runs of the same eval case (90 days); left blank until a k-run eval exists — never estimated. Office hours = Mon–Fri 08:00–17:30 Vietnam time. Cost in USD from runs.

rental.pick_company: Pick a company at the top to see its roles.
rental.roles_explain: Company roles: a person with a role here (who is not an org owner/admin) only sees and works inside this company. The company owner is the company's final approver (instead of the org owner); approvers receive approvals from rules set to “Company approver”. One person can hold seats in several companies — one seat per company.

rental.share_code: send this code to the renter
rental.out_explain: Lease one of this company's agents to another organization. The renter gets a NEW seat in their own company (own workspace, memory and sessions — none of your internal memory). Your floor (prohibitions, hard rules, allowed tools, data rules, spend cap) sits at the top of AGENTS.md and is enforced by the system; the renter can only add or tighten. You see usage and revenue, never the renter's customer data or tasks.
rental.in_explain: An agent leased from another organization works as a seat of this company: your charter, authority matrix and hard rules apply — plus the provider's floor, which you can't loosen. You approve the agent's business actions; policy/platform changes (model, tools, spend cap) go to the provider as a change request. You pay real model cost + markup and the contract fees.

rental.tools_hint: company_… tool names, comma separated; empty = the source agent's position

docs.core_summary_auto: (Auto-summarised by heading — short documents go in verbatim)
docs.override: I've reviewed the conflicts — publish anyway
docs.facts_explain: The company's official figures, each with its source (document code + version + section, or entered by hand). Extracted automatically from published documents; two sources disagreeing = a conflict, soft-blocked at approval. Agents read them via company_fact_get.
docs.facts_empty: No facts yet — publish a policy with return days, warranty… or enter one by hand.
docs.fact_manual: Enter by hand (wins when agents look up)
docs.req_explain: Records and documents the company should hold, applied by entity type, number of HUMAN employees (agent seats don't count), personal-data processing and industry. Met = a live document of the right type, or one attached to the item. Required items feed the "Records & documents" readiness layer.
docs.ret_explain: Retention dates are computed from the retention class (accounting records: fiscal year end + 5/10 years per Decree 174/2016). Deleting early is blocked; when due, the owner gets one Inbox card and only the owner can dispose — afterwards only metadata + hash remain.
docs.ret_empty: No documents with a disposal date yet.
docs.ret_confirm: Dispose of this record's content? Only metadata and hash remain — this cannot be undone.
docs.why_no_personal_data: the company declared it processes no personal data

cat.explain: The company's products/services and price list — the ONLY price source for agents (tool company_product_lookup, not document text). Prices default to VND. A price change adds a new history row and goes through the authority matrix: under {p0}% → department head, {p0}% or more, or a first price → owner. Agents only see prices in effect.
cat.name: Name
cat.empty_hint: Add a product with its first price — sales/support agents look prices up here.
cat.policy_hint: Leave returns / warranty empty: agents use the company-wide figures (Company facts).
cat.created_pending: Product added — first price awaiting approval
cat.preview_hint: Type a customer question — this is exactly what company_product_lookup returns to agents (no model call).
cat.preview_ph: e.g. how much is the blue glaze bowl?
cat.thr_line: Price changes of {p0}% or more (up or down), or a first price → owner approves; under {p0}% → department head.
cat.thr_hint: 1 to 100%. Applies to price proposals from now on; pending proposals keep the routing they were sent with.

ingest.explain: Bring existing documents into the library: files (PDF, scans, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…), web pages, ready-made templates, or sync from Google Drive / Notion. Everything imported lands as a draft — agents only read it after approval. Classification and extracted facts are suggestions only.
ingest.file_hint: Text or scanned PDF (read with OCR), images, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, MD/TXT/CSV/HTML, files exported from Drive/Notion. Up to 20 MB. A file already in the library (same sha256) is refused.
ingest.as_record: This is a record (kept even if no text can be read)
ingest.done: Imported — the document is a draft
ingest.url_hint: Marketplace policies, legal texts, your shop's policy pages…
ingest.tpl_hint: Reference templates for Vietnamese businesses, pre-filled with your company name. Not legal advice — fill in the '……' parts and have them reviewed before submitting.
ingest.src_hint: Connect the company's Google Drive (folder) or Notion (pages): checked hourly, a change creates a new draft for approval — never auto-published. Without a connected account, export the file from Drive/Notion and upload it above.
ingest.cred_ph: Leave empty if you don't have one yet
ingest.empty_hint: Upload a file or start from a template.
ingest.pii: {p0} ID numbers, {p1} phones, {p2} emails → personal data, hidden from agents
ingest.note_image_no_ocr: Scanned image: Tesseract isn't installed on the server, so no text was read — stored as a record.
ingest.note_ocr_eng_only: OCR has only the English pack — Vietnamese diacritics may be wrong; please proofread.
ingest.note_pdf_ocr: PDF had no text layer — OCR applied
ingest.note_pdf_ocr_eng: PDF had no text layer — OCR applied (English pack only, check diacritics)
ingest.note_pdf_no_ocr: PDF has no text layer (scan) and the server has no Tesseract/pdftoppm for OCR.
ingest.note_template_ref: Reference template, not legal advice — fill in the '……' blanks before submitting for approval

learn.explain: Documents improve from operations: agent flags, questions agents/customers couldn't find answers to (clustered from {p0} asks), approved lessons and agent proposals → one DRAFT on the document. A draft only takes effect after the owner edits it, submits it and it is approved through the authority matrix. Once published, the source flags and gaps close and the retrieval eval re-runs to compare before / after. Customer personal data (names, phone, email, ID numbers) is removed before it reaches a draft.
learn.gap_rate_na: Gap rate per lookup: not measured — lookups per period aren't counted yet, so no made-up number is shown.
learn.eval_no_agent: The company has no agent to run the eval as
learn.eval_not_applicable: The available eval set doesn't match this company's documents

crm.explain: Your company's customers (not platform tenants). Each data-processing consent has a purpose, channel, timestamp and evidence; when a customer withdraws, the system blocks marketing messages — for people and agents alike. Agents only see consented customers of their own department, with phone/email always masked.
crm.name: Name
crm.empty_hint: Add your first customer, then record consent with evidence.
crm.form_hint: Collect only what the purpose needs. After adding, record consent on the detail page — it can't be saved without evidence (silence isn't consent).
crm.consent_hint: Each consent is an immutable row. Withdrawal records time + reason; re-consent creates a new row.
crm.evidence_ph: e.g. Web form 16 Oct, unticked checkbox
crm.outreach_title: Log / request a message to the customer
crm.outreach_hint: The only gate for marketing messages: the system checks consent for the purpose and channel, and blocks + logs otherwise. It does not send to external channels yet.
crm.req_opened: Request opened — task + Inbox item created
crm.preview_hint: Exactly what company_customer_lookup returns to an agent of the chosen department: consented (service/AI) customers only, PII masked.
crm.privacy_explain: Customers' personal-data requests. Each becomes a deadline task for the owner + an Inbox card; completion leaves evidence (export hash / pre-erase hash).
crm.deadlines_line: Respond within {p0} working days · access/correct/provide {p1} days · withdraw/restrict/object {p2} days · delete {p3} days.
crm.legal_note: Reference only, not legal advice; extensions and exceptions (Art. 19, Law 91/2025) need review.
crm.req_empty_hint: Open requests from a customer's detail page.

biz.err_consent_evidence_required: Consent evidence is required (how, when, where stored) — silence isn't consent.
biz.err_consent_exists: An active consent already exists for this purpose + channel.
biz.err_no_marketing_consent: Blocked: the customer hasn't consented to marketing on this channel (or withdrew).
biz.err_contact_erased: This contact was erased on request.
biz.err_not_found: Not found (or belongs to another company).
biz.err_contract_locked: Contract is sent/signed: terms are locked — make an addendum.
biz.err_missing_fields: A partner and a start date are required before sending for signature.
biz.err_not_the_approver: You are not the signer under the authority matrix.
biz.err_self_approval: The requester can't approve their own request.
biz.err_end_before_start: End date must be after start date.
biz.err_code_exists: This number already exists in the company.
biz.err_not_draft: Only draft or rejected contracts can be sent.
biz.err_not_active: Only active contracts can be terminated.
biz.err_minutes_in_review: Minutes are in review — return to draft to edit.
biz.err_minutes_empty: Minutes are empty — draft them first.
biz.err_basis_required: Give the authority basis (charter / resolution / matrix).
biz.err_decider_lacks_authority: The decider lacks authority for this action type under the matrix.
biz.err_decider_must_be_human: Decisions must be made by a person.
biz.err_decision_text_required: A title and decision text are required.
biz.err_not_in_effect: The decision is no longer in force.
biz.err_no_rule: No matrix rule for this action type — write the basis manually.
biz.err_future_date: Entries can't be dated in the future.
biz.err_no_active_price: The product has no active price — enter the amount.

ct.explain: Register of contracts with suppliers, partners and business customers. Signing follows the authority matrix (“Contract” action); signed contracts lock their terms. Notice and end dates go to the compliance calendar; at {p0} days out the owner gets a task + Inbox card. Agents read key terms and SLA — never the signed file or the value.
ct.empty_hint: Add a partner first, then a draft contract, then send it for signature.
ct.title: Contract title
ct.locked_hint: Sent for signature / signed: terms are locked — make an addendum (new contract) to change them.
ct.preview_hint: Exactly what company_contract_get returns to agents: active contracts only, key terms + SLA, no value.
ct.preview_none: No matching active contract for agents

mt.explain: Meetings, minutes and the company's decision log. Approved minutes are locked and stored as a record (Enterprise Law Art. 11). Follow-ups become real tasks for the right people. Each decision records who decided, the authority basis and the effective dates; agents read in-force decisions via a tool.
mt.empty_hint: Add a meeting, take notes during it, then draft the minutes.
mt.title: Meeting title
mt.basis_ph: e.g. Charter Art. 12; council resolution no…
mt.locked_hint: Approved minutes are locked. Create a new meeting record for amendments.
mt.preview_hint: Exactly what company_decision_log returns to agents: in-force decisions, newest first.
mt.preview_none: No matching in-force decision for agents

fin.scope_body: Record income and expenses to see monthly profit/loss and remaining budget. It does not replace statutory books (Circular 133/200), financial statements, tax returns or e-invoices — you need an accountant / accounting software (use Export CSV). Business money is in VND; platform costs (USD) live under Costs and are not mixed in.
fin.no_budgets: No budget set for this month
fin.preview_hint: Exactly what company_finance_budget returns to an agent (no department): budget / spent / remaining, no individual entries.
fin.preview_none: No budget visible to the agent

bv.title: Brand voice
bv.explain: Your company's brand voice: personality, forms of address, preferred / banned words, emoji, per-channel rules, examples and spoken voice. The published version is compiled (briefly) into every agent's AGENTS.md and used to score customer-facing text. Edits = a new draft → submit → an admin publishes.
bv.demo: Demo draft — edit before real use
bv.wait_admin: Waiting for the company owner / an admin to approve.
bv.read_only: You have view-only access to the brand voice.
bv.persona_hint: Who the brand sounds like, and its attitude (1–3 sentences).
bv.traits_hint: One pair per row, e.g. warm — not overfamiliar.
bv.avoid_hint: Empty = default (tao, mày, tớ, cậu, bạn, tôi — minus the ones used above).
bv.lexicon_hint: Brand / product names and abbreviations with how to say them — applied before text-to-speech.
bv.core_hint: Published version, {p0}/{p1} chars. Agents read per-channel detail via company_doc_get doc_code=VOICE.
bv.core_empty: Nothing published yet — agents get no voice section.
bv.channels_explain: Each channel has its own tone, greeting/closing, max length and emoji. Empty = default / from the Text tab.
bv.examples_explain: Good / bad pairs per situation. Good ones must pass, bad ones must be caught by the checker.
bv.no_examples_hint: Add common situations: price question, broken item, complaint.
bv.voice_explain: Spoken voice for calls / read-outs: TTS provider, voice, speed, call greeting and closing scripts. Listening calls the real provider (uses quota) and stores the file.
bv.voice_name_hint: Provider voice id, e.g. nova, coral
bv.style_hint: A hint for the model, e.g. warm, unhurried, smiling
bv.tts_failed: The voice provider returned an error — no audio was created
bv.tts_failed_hint: This is the provider's real error (e.g. out of quota). Top up or switch provider, then try again.
bv.try_hint: Paste a message / post — the deterministic checker looks at banned words, address, emoji, channel length, formatting, signature.
bv.try_ph: e.g. Dạ em chào anh/chị ạ…
bv.enforce_hint: Applies to customer-facing text in agent outputs (company_task_submit_output). A leased seat's provider bans always send work back.
bv.model_check: Allow model grading (uses quota, advisory only)
bv.model_unavailable: No model API configured on the server — enabling will report errors.
bv.admin_only: Only the company owner / admins can change settings.
bv.eval_hint: Builds an eval set from the examples (no banned words, correct address) — run k times from each agent's Career card.
bv.err_term_conflict: "{term}" is both a preferred and a banned term.
bv.err_in_review: A version is awaiting approval — approve / reject it before editing.
bv.err_not_draft: Only a draft can do this.
bv.err_empty_voice: The voice is empty — add a persona, a we-are pair or banned words.
bv.err_self_approval: Submitters can't approve their own version — ask the owner or another admin.
bv.err_no_published_voice: The company has no published brand voice.
bv.err_invalid_voice: Voice id may only contain letters, digits, - _ .
bv.err_no_voice_profile: Save the voice profile before listening.
bv.err_no_examples: Add at least one example first.
bv.err_tts_provider_quota: The voice provider is out of quota: {message}
bv.err_tts_provider_auth: The provider rejected the API key: {message}
bv.err_tts_provider_error: The voice provider returned an error: {message}
bv.err_tts_not_configured: No voice provider (CometAPI) is configured on the server.
bv.err_tts_audio_too_large: The audio file is too large.
